info.name: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST Advanced Search Third-Party Analysis API

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Enter the application internal id. Use the Applications REST API to retrieve theapplication internal id.

params.name: source
params.description: Specify the specification name of the SBOM to be evaluated. Allowed values are `cyclonedx` and `spdx`

params.name: stageId
params.description: Enter the stageId to run the evaluation for. The policy actions will be determined by the stage selected. Allowed values are `develop`, `build`, `stage-release`, `release` and `operate`

items.docs:
